description: Foundation: additive Card Authentication tokens + the shared split-screen auth shell + hero asset + auth i18n scaffolding. This leaves all three auth routes (login/register/forgot-password) rendering inside the new Figma shell while they still show their current inner content, so the tree stays buildable. Independent of FEAT-003/004 in logic, but MUST land first because the other features build on the shell, tokens, and i18n keys. Grounded in the Login node 47:3798 get_design_context already fetched during planning.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/figma-auth/context.json and this file FIRST. Then read .agents/design-system/figma-auth.md (source of truth) and src/app/globals.css.

In src/app/globals.css, add additive tokens to :root: '--card-auth-surface: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.4); /* #f4f4f5 */' and '--card-auth-border: oklch(0.712 0.013 286.1); /* #a1a1aa */' (values intentionally equal to --muted and --muted-foreground). Add matching .dark overrides consistent with the muted treatment (e.g. surface oklch(0.269 0 0), border oklch(0.708 0 0)). In @theme inline add '--color-card-auth-surface: var(--card-auth-surface);' and '--color-card-auth-border: var(--card-auth-border);'. Reuse the existing --radius-card-xl (24px) for the card radius — do NOT add a new radius token. Do NOT modify any existing token.

Download the auth hero image: from the Login get_design_context the hero is the 'image 4' PNG. Run the figma power get_design_context on node 47:3798 (fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR) to get the current asset URL, then 'curl -L "<url>" -o public/auth/hero.png' (create public/auth/ if missing). Never reference the temporary Figma URL at runtime.

Rework src/app/[locale]/(auth)/layout.tsx into the Figma split-screen shell while keeping it a Server Component, keeping setRequestLocale(locale) and the default export signature 'AuthLayout({ children, params }: LayoutProps<"/[locale]">)'. Structure: a <main id="main-content"> centering a row with max-w-[1280px], gap-6, items-center; a 628px image column (lg:block, hidden below lg, h-[748px] max, rounded-card-xl, overflow-hidden) containing a next/image (fill, object-cover) of /auth/hero.png with an empty alt (decorative); and a flex-1 min-w-0 auth card: bg-card-auth-surface, border border-card-auth-border, rounded-card-xl, p-6, flex flex-col items-center gap-12, holding {children}. Use logical properties only. On mobile the image column is hidden and the card is full-width.

Extend the auth namespace in BOTH messages/ar.json and messages/en.json (in sync) with the Figma copy keys needed by later features: loginHeading='قم بتسجيل الدخول إلى حسابك', loginSubheading='أدخل بيانات اعتمادك للوصول إلى حسابك', emailLabel='الايميل الشخصي', emailPlaceholder='قم بادخال ايميلك الشخصي', passwordLabel='كلمة السر', passwordPlaceholder='قم بادخال كلمة السر', forgotPasswordLink='هل نسيت كلمة السر ؟', registerFooterPrefix='ليس لديك حساب؟', registerFooterCta='سجل الآن'. Add sensible English equivalents. Keep the auth key set identical between ar.json and en.json.
acceptance_criteria: bg-card-auth-surface and border-card-auth-border are usable Tailwind utilities (confirmed by a successful npm run build), and no existing token value changed.
public/auth/hero.png exists and is a valid PNG referenced via next/image (not a Figma URL).
(auth)/layout.tsx is a Server Component rendering the split shell; all three auth routes still build and render their existing inner content inside the new card.
messages/ar.json and messages/en.json have identical auth key sets including the new keys; messages-parity test stays green.
verification: From repo root: npm run typegen ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint ; npm run test ; npm run build — all pass with 0 errors.
Confirm public/auth/hero.png exists and next/image references the local path.
findings:
DONE. All 5 gates pass with 0 errors (typegen, typecheck, lint, test 145/145, build) on the commit.

TOKENS (globals.css): added additive --card-auth-surface (#f4f4f5, == --muted) and --card-auth-border (#a1a1aa, == --muted-foreground) to :root, with .dark overrides (surface oklch(0.269 0 0), border oklch(0.708 0 0)). Mapped in @theme inline as --color-card-auth-surface and --color-card-auth-border. Tailwind utilities available for later features: `bg-card-auth-surface` and `border-card-auth-border`. Card radius reuses the existing `rounded-card-xl` (24px) token — no new radius added. No existing token changed.

HERO ASSET: public/auth/hero.png (valid PNG, ~1.15MB, 628x748 source from Figma image 4 node 212:906). Reference via next/image local path '/auth/hero.png' — NEVER the Figma URL (expired/temporary).

AUTH SHELL (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/layout.tsx): Server Component, keeps setRequestLocale(locale) and signature AuthLayout({ children, params }: LayoutProps<"/[locale]">). Structure: <main id="main-content"> (flex, items-center, justify-center, px-4 py-12) > centered row div (flex w-full max-w-[1280px] items-center gap-6). Image column: `relative hidden h-[748px] w-[628px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-card-xl lg:block` holding a next/image (fill, priority, sizes="628px", object-cover, empty alt=decorative). Auth card: `flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-12 rounded-card-xl border border-card-auth-border bg-card-auth-surface p-6` wrapping {children}. Image column hidden below lg; card full-width on mobile. Logical properties only.

I18N (messages/ar.json + en.json, auth namespace, in sync): added keys loginHeading, loginSubheading, emailLabel, emailPlaceholder, passwordLabel, passwordPlaceholder, forgotPasswordLink, registerFooterPrefix, registerFooterCta. AR = exact Figma copy; EN = sensible equivalents. NOTE: these are NEW keys added alongside the pre-existing auth keys (loginTitle/loginSubtitle/registerTitle/email/password/forgotPassword/noAccount/loginCta/registerCta/roles/validation/errors/success) which later features may also use. The messages-parity test only asserts the `organisms` namespace, but auth key sets were kept identical between ar and en anyway.

SPACING MAP (from context.json, confirmed matches Figma): p-6=24 (card padding), gap-12=48 (sections), gap-6=24 (sub-sections / image-card gap), gap-3=12 (heading/input-field gap). Reusable tokens already present: --text-body -> text-text-body (#52525a body text), --radius-card-xl -> rounded-card-xl.

FIGMA LOGIN REF (node 47:3798, fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR) pulled for later features: logo 140x144 at card top; heading block gap-3 items-center text-center (title Paragraph lg Semibold 20/32 weight600 #18181b, subtitle Paragraph xsm Regular 14/20 #52525a); fields block gap-6 w-full, each Input Field flex flex-col gap-3 items-end w-[578px]; label Paragraph sm Medium 16/24 #18181b + red '*' (#ef4444); input md: bg #f4f4f5, border #e4e4e7, radius 8px(sm), px-8/py-12, placeholder #a1a1aa Paragraph xsm; email field trailing Email icon; password field leading Eye toggle (PasswordToggle molecule) + trailing Password icon; forgot link Paragraph xsm Medium underlined secondary #14b8a6 text-end full-width; submit Button primary md full-width bg #123458 border #102f50 radius 12px(md) py-12 label Paragraph xsm Medium #fafafa; footer centered Paragraph xsm Medium prefix #18181b + 'سجل الآن' secondary #14b8a6 underlined link to register. Hero asset constant in that node was imgImage4 (now downloaded); logo SVG imgLogo (89:4902) — prefer existing LogoMark component.
